files.description: The registered (b)(10) EHI export documentation. A single-page PDF that states clinical data exports as CCDA 2.1 Release 2 (USCDI v1) and billing data exports as CSV, XLSX, or PDF. Contains no data dictionary, no field definitions, no schema, and no instructions.

KanTime Patient API documentation (14 pages). Describes the REST API for retrieving patient clinical data as CCDA XML — the technical mechanism for the clinical side of the EHI export. Includes authentication, patient search, full CCDA retrieval, and section-specific queries with sample curl commands and response examples.

SMART on FHIR API documentation (66 pages). This is the (g)(10) FHIR API documentation, NOT the (b)(10) EHI export. Covers standard US Core FHIR resources via SMART on FHIR. Downloaded for completeness and context on what the FHIR API covers vs the EHI export.
FHIR R4 endpoint Bundle JSON listing KanTime FHIR service base URLs and associated organizations. Part of (g)(10) compliance, not (b)(10) EHI export. Downloaded for completeness.
